args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
============================

Based on your Hawaii trip from June 10th - June 20th, 2024

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple sets recommended)
- Sunscreen (high SPF, reef-safe)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (light, breathable clothing)
- Camera (for capturing memories)
- Travel documents (passport/ID, hotel confirmations, flight details)

Additional Recommendations:
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses
- Hat or cap for sun protection
- Water shoes (for snorkeling at Hanauma Bay)
- Light rain jacket (for potential showers)
- Insect repellent
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkel gear (optional, can be rented)
- Formal attire (if planning any upscale dinners)
- Beach bag
- Flip flops/sandals
- Comfortable walking shoes

Don't forget to check weather forecasts before finalizing your packing!
